memory_candidates.content: The --lit flag injects files from specs/literature/ as <literature-context> into agent prompts. It is independent of --clean: --clean suppresses memory retrieval while --lit adds literature injection. They can be combined. The literature-retrieve.sh script has TOKEN_BUDGET=4000 tokens and MAX_FILES=10. The directory is user-maintained, not task-scoped, and is silently skipped when absent.
